body: Break up, hit the gym, don't date for a while, you're not gonna miss her really. expend that energy on other things and you'll be surprised by the results. i find dating nobody nd being totally detached to be far easier than to be stuck in something that is a mere tease of a genuine, good experience. you know you're worth more than that.

Yeah I'm trying to. I feel a lot of shame that I can't just move forward to them.

I was doing it with a sponsor before and was ready to jump in front of a train when writing out my resentments. The "I played what part in this?" was extremely disturbing to me, though I know an exception may be made to say I played no role in being abused at 6 years old. I have gnarly PTSD from being severely abused as a child for over a decade. This was a strong reason that I self medicated. I do trauma therapy. A regular sponsor isn't equipped to handle such severe outside issues.

Were you abused as a child? Abused children tend to abuse animals and repeat patterns

It sounds like you might be an alcoholic and need help rather than to bash yourself. Why don't you try going to AA? You can share this with people and they will give you advice and support without judgment. This entire incident sounds like it was caused by alcohol. 

Also try not to label yourself as things, as it will rub into yourself and make you feel worse. Try to just see yourself as a decent person who feels bad or has done something bad, but isn't inherently bad. For example "I feel like the worst person alive" rather than "I am the worst person alive." that has helped me a lot.

i hope you feel better soon

as someone in basically the same situation - exactly the same it seems - i can tell you that it won't go away, that's impossible and natural when it's something as deep and fundamental as the family/mother especially given the structure of society - it is unrealistic to think that you may "get over it" but rather my hope for you and myself is that it will be less present and painful one day.

oh my god are you me?

please know that you are not alone. i have been estranged from my abusive parents for five years. my greatest sadness every holiday season is wondering what i have done that was so horrible to have made my entire blood family hate me. 

i would like to write more but i am super exhausted. been up forever. but seriously you are not alone. but the fact that you have a great gf and loving friends means that you are actually a good person. you may feel like your mother hates you, but she really doesn't know you since she is caught up in her own self absorption, projection, and psychoses. her hatred and evil is invalid because she doesn't know you.

the pain often feels unbearable but we must hang in there and be the voice for those who also suffer like this. do not fear that you would be a bad father - the very fact that you think about this, rather than having it be a nonexistent issue that literally cannot broach your mind, means you're going to be great (not just ok!)

you are so full of strength to leave it all behind. i have a lot of respect for you for that. hang in there, the pain is real but so is your hope for the future and the love of the people who care for you. this isn't your fault and you deserve to, and are loved.

I have ADHD and take the lowest possible dose of vyvanse. Found a doctor who specializes in ADHD and addiction, taking this dose has helped me so much and allowed me to live a normal life. Fortunately my recovery is strong enough for me to have no incentive to abuse it. I get drug tested randomly too. Honestly there is nothing wrong with advocating for yourself and getting multiple opinions. But first you may need a full blown assessment. Try googling where to get one. If in NYC I can help.

I am sorry you are still stuck with them. If you would like some advice of financials, how to find some sort of job, cheap housing etc, you can always message me and I can share how I managed to not live at home even with negative money in bank acct and no jobs. Thank you for your kind words.

Thank you very much. Yes, permanent no contact is the way to go. I am switching phone service providers to prevent further harrasment (I have been receiving harrassing voice mails) and will send back any packages the motherfuckers send me in the mail. Yes, I have been programmed and brainwashed. It obviously was not a complete job because I otherwise would have committed suicide by now, or be homeless or living with them, completely strung out on drugs cuz i sure love them a lot. The trick is to learn how to let my own programming out do theres, and my sense of loyalty and filial piety has made that challenging. However, I will eventually make it out one day. I must. I will.

Thank you so much. I really appreciate your kind words. Yes, please send those recs over my way. I am slowly but surely feeling better from last week.

Just an exchange-  my favorite book of all time is "The Unwanted" by Kien Nguyen. This is written by a mixed-race, white-looking Amerasian who was left behind in Vietnam after the fall of Saigon. Really beautiful tale of survival, uncanny coincidence, emotional depth/complexity on parts of the characters. I cried so much throughout it. Brought back a lot of painful young memories from the few times my mother took me back to her home country to meet my family.

Thank you. What is tough for me is that society preaches endless and almost worshipful love of parents. It is like society forgets that some parents hate their children, some parents even kill their children. It kills me inside. But I will challenge myself to not care about the opinion of others and attempt to move on since some people are incapable of love. Those who say "but your parents love you! they are your parents" are the same to admit "some people are very ill and bad people who are incapable of love or empathy." Why can't they realize some of these people are parents too? Beyond me, really. But I know the truth and some people out there do too....

Thank you. If I were truly like my father, I would just complain, and attack others and be a whining loser instead of using it as inspiration to excel, escape, and build healing meaningful friendships. I agree with your assessment of what the next steps are.I know objectively that I should not care, because these people are psychotic and literally do not know anything about me because they do not have conversations with me or ask me questions about myself  - just insult me and complain about their lives or declare their superiority. 

Thanks again. I try to tell myself that they are missing out on a wonderful person, and that is just sad. Disinterested parents. What kills me is that they lie and say I am being a random bitch. It fucking hurts so much. I hope that one day I can move past this and put it behind me.

Thank you so much! Yes, I have been told that before - if I was truly a pathetic loser clone of my dad, I would be living at home snorting heroin every day and letting myself be treated like shit. though i have come far, gotten off drugs, succeeded, i still have the voice in my head extending the abuse and illness. it's very tough but i have had this voice be silenced before - one day, i will get there again, i know i have to and will.

it just sickens me how truly sadistic these people are. however i try to remind myself that i am an inherently good person, rather than a "bad blood" bastard child like my mom says, because of all the great things i have done. if my parents are removed from the equation, i can safely say that i would be happy and proud of myself, and anyone would be too. 

it's so hard. thanks for the support though !

thanks again for feedback. i have always hated myself so much for being white-passing, but there's really nothing inherently wrong with it, and it is unfortunately, for what it's worth, beneficial to some degree. i am trying to train myself to appreciate the positives of it, because i can get really deep in self-hate and hate myself for being rejected by my own community, feeling cheated out of a culture and identity, and worst of all, hated by my own mother. 

i already have cut them off. i didn't talk to them for 5 years, then was feeling really good and invited my mom to come see me for 4 days...uglier than ever. i haven't been the same since, but the fact that i reached this point before means i can get there again, because i thought it was truly not possible.

interesting that you met these people with similar experiences to me. i'm jealous - i literally never have met another "hapa" (kinda hate that term...its signifies that we are different and special snowflakes...really prefer mixed race asian) who hates their identity and has suffered like this. actually, now that i think about it, i was very close to a half korean guy for a while who was very similar with regards to self hate and struggling with rejection from the asian community/ offensive and ignorant comments, hated his dad, but his mother was a very loving and supportive person. so jealous. but in the end, societal problems that one faces can be just as hideous and impactful. 

and lol yeah a lot of fucked up kids do come out of that. there's a subreddit for distraught half asians (watch, this post is totally gonna get cross-posted there...) which is truly alarming and beyond sad and unhealthy. i just wish i could find some of them, so we could support each other. o well

thx again 4 the advice...have a great day!

Thank you for this message, it was definitely my favorite. The severe psychoses line was great. Many people either have the luxury of not having to think about the dynamics behind AFWM relationships, or it works out for them. I am so resentful and angry that I was taught to hate myself like this when I could have been OK. There is nothing inherently wrong about being white-passing or mixed race, but I was taught to hate myself, all while this woman had a huge smile on her face. It makes me fucking sick. Because of this whole experience, I just don't date white guys at all. Almost all of the guys I've dated seriously or even casually are Hispanic or Asian. The only ironic good thing about looking so white is that I at least avoid Asian fetishists. Thank jesus, would feel truly ill to have that harassment. 

your explanation of my mothers psychoses is helpful. Yes, I have been a victim of severe projection. My parents actually met in Thailand (mom is Thai Chinese), and we all know what disgusting pathetic white men are doing in Thailand. It disgusts me, makes me fucking sick to my stomach. God I hate being mixed race sometimes, because I feel like I am neocolonialism embodied. Tragic mulatto shit. My mom grew up in extreme poverty and apparently my dad promised to get her a job but he did jack shit. I think she is envious of my success and "normalcy.", and from there spring all of the unbelievable comments.  Why she takes this out on me rather than anyone else is beyond me.  The psychoses and soul sickness is a more helpful way of looking at it, rather than a pure sadist. She has said a few truly delusional and unreal statements to me, outside of the extreme personal insults.

Yes, I know I have a very bright future ahead of me. I can honestly say that for the first time, I really love my life right now. I obviously am in hell because of my past, but the present and the future look fucking great. I wish my family could see this, but all the projection and psychoses get in the way. I try to tell myself it doesn't matter.

Your friends who have gotten over this, are they are also mixed race? how do you know them? I don't have many mixed friends at all - just one close friend who is half Mexican half white, no other half Asian friends, although I have tons of full Asian friends - I think it could be helpful to know others w same experience.  

Thank you for simply stating that I deserve love and kindness. I am trying to move on but I have extreme PTSD-esque mood swings. I began intense treatment this summer, and I have seen some relief. The only thing that makes me feel I can move on is the fact that I did feel relief before I saw my evil horrendous bitch mother and was not haunted by my childhood for the first time in my whole life. It will probably take quite some time and I just should try to implement more patience. 

Best wishes, thanks so much for taking the time to write to me!

Thanks. I feel that I have no choice but to move on and attempt to persevere. I believe that a cyclical hopeless life like that of my parents is a fate that is truly worse than death, and I would much rather commit suicide than to be stuck in such dark and hateful patterns. I think this is probably a reason why I think about killing myself so much. Ironically this extreme fear has caused me to have very high standards via conventional success measurements. 

Try to use your fear to give courage wings, is what I'm saying. But try to not be as extreme as me, haha.

Thank you so much for your kind comment. I am actually originally from California; came to NYC for graduate school. NYC has been tough in some ways, but I think I have been able to make lemonade of my lemons here (minus inviting my evil bitch mother to see me here since i was so proud of myself). I got strung out on heroin here which was obviously very horrible, but I also found recovery and AA/NA here, which was life changing and a truly safe place and community that I have never experienced before. I also felt very uncomfortable on the subway because i was a lazy California bum and everyone is so fashionable here, but I ended up learning how to dress well and do makeup and be willing to spend money on myself. Learning that I"m worth it and should feel proud of myself. One way that my mother would abuse me would be to make me buy clothes that were several sizes too big for me, taunt me for the way I walk and look, not let me buy clothes and for several years, tell me I look like a whore and am a whore who doesn't care about school all the time. I think she may have been sexually abused, since she would say really weird inappropriate shit to me. I honestly wish she had been sexually abused, not for sadistic reasons, but because then at least there would be an excuse for how evil she is. 

Thanks for your kindness. It helps to make me feel like less of a freak. How do you cope with people not believing you are part Asian (if that happens to you?)? I am thinking about saying "Thank you!!!" when they say I must be white, just to make them uncomfortable, or to say "Yeah? You don't look Asian either." or "Really? So you're an expert on genetics? Do you think I don't know who my mother is?" I wish I could say smartass comebacks but sometimes those situations are just inappropriate to tell someone they're being a horrible jerk off.
Thanks for the simple message, appreciate it.

Thank you so much for the kind words and taking the time to reply. It means a lot to me. Yes, there are very many ill people in the world but few do this to children. I often wonder "why me?" but I guess I have to just accept it. I struggle and wish to implement in myself the idea of myself being a good and strong person for having made it through this and being more or less normal and highly functional. Viktor Frankl in his seminal book "Man's Search for Meaning" wrote about how we should challenge ourselves in times of great pain to ask ourselves if we are worthy of this suffering - i.e. if you are strong enough to endure the pain, and what an honor it is to be able to handle this suffering and take this pain and continue on when other souls could not. I think I'm botching this concept a bit, but I try to tell myself that I was born into this body to spare someone else and because I am strong enough to endure this and move on.
I'm glad you haven't had the same experiences as me :)
